title: Ultra Rich Ukrainian Duck Dumplings
description: A hearty and comforting Ukrainian dish featuring duck and a rich mother sauce, perfect for a sick day or a cold winter night.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, eggs, and a pinch of salt, and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of about 1/4 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a tablespoon of shredded duck breast in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Bring the chicken broth to a boil in a large pot, then reduce the heat to a simmer.
Carefully add the dumplings to the pot and cook for 10 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
While the dumplings are cooking, melt the butter in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Add the sour cream to the saucepan and stir until it is heated through.
Season the sauce with salt, pepper, and dill weed.
